bio: In the heart of Chamberí, this elegant restaurant has been built on four solid pillars: personality, professionalism, hard work and an unbreakable will! The driving force behind the project is Rubén Hernández Mosquero, a globetrotting chef from Extremadura who has worked in some of the most prestigious establishments (Noma and Geranium in Copenhagen; Azurmendi in Larrabetzu; Il Ristorante at the Bvlgari Hotel Tokyo; Minibar by José Andrés in Washington; Atomix in New York...). EMi, a heartfelt tribute to his brother (Emilio, now deceased), has been devised as a haute cuisine bar for a maximum of 12 diners, with a fully open kitchen and a small private room overlooking the stoves.
